verdict.rationale: The evidence only shows monday.com acting as an MCP server: a hosted MCP URL, a developer MCP that external agents connect to, and reaching monday agents via 'our MCP'. Nothing shows monday's own agents connecting to third-party MCP servers to use their tools. Since monday ships agents, MCP-client support is a fair question for this product, so the axis applies. Server-side MCP and developer building blocks like 'agent skills' are a different capability and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
